title: CPF Module Schema:
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-azureaistudiohub'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

applicationInsights.description: (Optional) ARM id of the application insights associated with this workspace.

containerRegistry.description: (Optional) ARM id of the container registry associated with this workspace.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

discoveryUrl.description: (Optional) Url for the discovery service to identify regional endpoints for AI Studio Hub services

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

featureStoreSettings.type: object({ computeRuntime = object({ sparkRuntimeVersion = string }) offlineStoreConnectionName = string onlineStoreConnectionName = string })
featureStoreSettings.description: (Optional) Feature store settings for the Azure AI Studio Hub. computeRuntime = { sparkRuntimeVersion = "(Optional) The version of the Spark runtime to use." } offlineStoreConnectionName = "(Optional) The name of the connection for the offline store." onlineStoreConnectionName = "(Optional) The name of the connection for the online store."

friendlyName.description: (Optional) The friendly name for this workspace. This name in mutable

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Type of managed service identity (where both SystemAssigned and UserAssigned types are allowed)." identity_ids = "(Optional) The set of user assigned identities associated with the resource." })

imageBuildCompute.description: (Optional) The compute name for image build.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

keyVault.description: (Required) ARM id of the key vault associated with this workspace. This cannot be changed once the workspace has been created

kind.description: (Optional) Enabling v1_legacy_mode may prevent you from using features provided by the v2 API.

name.description: (Required) Name of the AI Hub Studio.

outboundRules.type: map(object({ category = string status = string type = string fqdn_destination = optional(string, null) service_tag_destination = optional(object({ action = string portRanges = string protocol = string serviceTag = string })) private_link_destination = optional(object({ serviceResourceId = string sparkEnabled = bool sparkStatus = string subResourceTarget = string })) }))
outboundRules.description: (Optional) An ssh block as defined below. object({ rule_name = "(Required) the name of the rule" category = "(Required) Category of a managed network Outbound Rule of a AI Studio Hub, possible value are Recommended,Required,UserDefined." status = "(Required) Type of a managed network Outbound Rule of a AI Studio Hub , possible value are Active,Inactive" type = "(Required) Set the object type, possible values are FQDN, ServiceTag and PrivateEndpoint" fqdn_destination = "(Optional) name of the FQDN" service_tag_destination = (Optional) object({ action = "(Required) The action enum for networking rule, supported values are Deny and Allow" portRanges = "(Required) The port ranges for service tag destination rule." protocol = "(Required) the protocol for service tag destination rule." serviceTag = "(Required) the service tag for service tag destination rule." }) private_link_destination = (Optional) object({ serviceResourceId = "(Required) The service reousrce id for private link destination" sparkEnabled = "(Required) Spark for the private link destination" sparkStatus = "(Required) Spark status for the private link destination" subResourceTarget = "(Required)sub resource for private link destination" }) })

parent_id.description: (Required) The ID of the azure resource in which this resource is created. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

primaryUserAssignedIdentity.description: (Optional)The user assigned identity resource id that represents the workspace identity.

serverlessComputeSettings.description: (Optional) Serverless compute settings for the Azure AI Studio Hub. serverlessComputeCustomSubnet = "(Optional) The resource ID of an existing virtual network subnet in which serverless compute nodes should be deployed" serverlessComputeNoPublicIP = "(Optional) The flag to signal if serverless compute nodes deployed in custom vNet would have no public IP addresses for a workspace with private endpoint"

serviceManagedResourcesSettings.description: (Optional) Settings for service managed resources. The object contains the following properties: cosmosDb = "(Optional) Cosmos DB settings." collectionsThroughput = "(Required) Throughput for collections in Cosmos DB."

sku.type: object({ capacity = number family = string name = string size = string tier = string })
sku.description: (Optional) The SKU settings for the Azure ML workspace. The object contains the following properties: capacity = "(Optional) The capacity of the SKU." family = "(Optional) The family of the SKU." name = "(Required) The name of the SKU." size = "(Optional) The size of the SKU." tier = "(Required) The tier of the SKU."

status.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ sparkReady = "(Required) Indicates if Spark is ready.." status = "(Optional) Status for the managed network of a AI Studio Hub." })

storageAccount.description: (Optional) ARM id of the storage account associated with this workspace. This cannot be changed once the workspace has been created

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

v1LegacyMode.description: (Optional) Enabling v1_legacy_mode may prevent you from using features provided by the v2 API.

id.description: The ID of the Azure AI Studio Hub.

name.description: The Name of the Azure AI Studio Hub.

resource.description: The Azure AI Studio Hub resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Azureaistudiohub' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
